dispatch.detail: One poll/dispatch/complete loop per thread over one shared context: a single loop on the calling thread under the default SyncExecutor, and a Swoole\Thread pool that grows on the core's starvation signal under SwooleExecutor. Which one is an axis of the run, not a property of this app.

env.FLEZHA_PHP_EXECUTOR: which executor drives the loop: sync (the default, one loop, stock NTS PHP) or swoole (a thread pool, needs a ZTS build with Swoole\Thread and ffi.enable=true). The entry script reads it from the environment, which is why the launch line names it nowhere: a runner inherits the run's environment, so the executor is an axis of the run rather than a property of this file
env.FLEZHA_MAX_ACTIVATIONS: shut down cleanly after this many activations so a supervisor can recycle the process (default: unlimited)
